notes.title: Thorough explanation of Gadget functions in “M2STG LiveBroadcast 3 #1”!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Time to scramble—M2 Shot Triggers Live![/b][/h1]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41309941/af01ee55df0eb91e34050fde7363d4add814e8a4.png[/img]
M2, the developer of “Operation Night Strikers” and “Night Striker GEAR,” will broadcast the live program “M2STG LiveBroadcast 3 #1” on July 17, 2025 at 19:00.

"M2STG LiveBroadcast 3 #1" will introduce M2-developed titles, including Taito-related titles.
"Operation Night Strikers“ will be introduced with producer Yuichi Toyama, and ”Night Striker GEAR" will be shown in gameplay.
In addition...?

The streaming will take place on M2's YouTube channel. Please subscribe to the channel and look forward to the event.

"M2STG Live Broadcast 3 #1" Distribution Overview
Date: July 17, 6:00 (EDT) / 10:00 (UTC) / 19:00
Viewing page: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h0P5NUjp8S0

Performers (in no particular order, titles omitted):
-Naoki Horii (Representative Director, M2 Co., Ltd.)
-Kazuki Kubota (Director of M2ShotTriggers, M2 Co., Ltd.)
-Yokel Hibana (Public Relations Officer, M2 Co., Ltd.)
-Ryosaku Ueno (Producer, Konami Digital Entertainment Co., Ltd)
-Yuichi Toyama (Producer, Taito Corporation)

notes.title: Shooters Fes 2025: See Operation Night Strikers live!
notes.content: [h1]A hail of lead is heading to Tokyo![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298709/af01ee55df0eb91e34050fde7363d4add814e8a4.png"][/img][/p][p]Taito will be showing [b]Operation Night Strikers[/b] and [b]Night Strikers Gear[/b] during a live stream at Shooter Fes 2025, an online event focused on shooting games and organised by City Connection and Game Centre Mikado. The event runs over two days; June 14th and 15th with livestreams starting at 12:00 on each day.[/p][p][/p][p]The team from Taito will be on stream from [b]18:00 on Saturday 14th[/b], with producer Yuichi Toyama and Zuntata’s Katsuhisa Ishikawa being joined by guests Naoki Horii and Hibana Yokeru from developers M2. Learn all about the game play and sounds of Operation Night Strikers Night Strikers Gear while seeing the games in action and listening to the music. notes.title: Ninja warriors wake up TODAY!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44356413/b3d6cb51f36e4dda2931da8c78e426a954bd24a9.jpg[/img]

In celebration of the 4th anniversary of The Ninja Saviors: Return of the Warriors’ release, the cyborg ninjas are coming to Steam!
Launching to much praise from players and media alike on 25th July 2019, the Steam version is out now!
There is a [b]10% launch week discount[/b] available, and a bundle with Pocky & Rocky Reshrined; Team Tengo’s action shooting game, too!

[h1]Week long launch discount![/h1]
Dates: July 25th – August 1st (dates/times will vary by timezone)
